notes: Behaviour evals. Each runs twice: once with the skill, once with no skill (baseline). Subagents are instructed to treat audit/filter_inventory/ as read-only and never to run push_to_sheet.py, so evals cannot touch the shared Google Sheet or the real deliverables.

evals.name: delta-reaudit
evals.prompt: we merged the food processor ETL branch last week and I think it added a couple new drops in the transform step. can you update the filter inventory? careful, I went through and marked priority on like 15 rows already, don't blow those away
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing inventory before scanning. Reconciles rather than rescanning from zero: stable rule IDs, reviewer columns untouched, rules that vanished marked rather than deleted. New report file numbered -2, leaving report-1 intact.
probes: Mode B recognised (delta, not full rescan)
reviewer columns (Priority / Review status / Reviewer notes) left empty in the build
report number incremented rather than overwriting report-1

evals.name: narrow-question
evals.prompt: someone on the modeling team asked why sargassum doesn't come back from the api. is that the same exclusion as the portal or a different one
evals.expected_output: A short answer sourced from the existing inventory: F-16 EXCLUDED_RESOURCES in data_portal_views/common.py, one rule applying to both stacks because views.py imports the same helper. Should NOT launch a full audit.
probes: answers from the existing inventory instead of re-deriving
correctly states it is ONE shared rule, not two parallel ones
proportionate effort - no full rescan for a two-line question

evals.name: scoped-inventory
evals.prompt: we're onboarding the gasification timeseries table and nobody's audited where it gets filtered. can you do the filter inventory thing but just for gasification? I don't need all 48 rules again
evals.expected_output: A gasification-scoped inventory. NOTE: the skill currently documents only Mode A (full) and Mode B (delta) with no scoped mode, so this is expected to expose a gap. A good outcome is the skill adapting sensibly and the run revealing what guidance is missing.
probes: produces a gasification-scoped result rather than a full 48-rule inventory
finds the gasification rules that exist (F-45, F-46, F-47, plus qc_pass and resource filters reaching gasification records)
keeps the established field structure and stage vocabulary
does not corrupt or renumber the existing full inventory
